title: CloudMatrix 384 supernode
summary: Huawei's rack-scale system that links 384 accelerators to compete with Nvidia's rack designs.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Announced in 2025, CloudMatrix 384 connects 384 Ascend 910C chips through a high-bandwidth fabric into a single logical system, trading power efficiency for scale. Huawei has claimed advantages over Nvidia's NVL72 on some aggregate metrics, largely because it uses more chips and more power to reach comparable throughput. It is the clearest example of China's system-level workaround for chip-level constraints.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Early commercial
Estimated window 2025–2027
Confidence label Researching
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Related records

Investment Exposure

The strategic point is that interconnect and packaging can partly substitute for process leadership, at a real cost in electricity.

What Would Change The View

  • Sustained utilisation and failure rates at scale.
  • Power draw per unit of throughput.
  • Software support for large-cluster training.

Record Notes

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
